fields.label: Client Name
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sClientName1 FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: C# record property: Name → JSON: name

fields.label: Secondary Name
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sClientName2 FROM tblClient WHERE sClientName2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sClientName2

fields.label: Mailing Country
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sMailCountry FROM tblClient WHERE sMailCountry IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sMailCountry — Mailing tab dropdown, typically 'USA'. DB column confirmed; NOT currently selected in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: Address 1
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sMailAddr1 FROM tblClient WHERE sMailAddr1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sMailAddr1

fields.label: Address 2
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sMailAddr2 FROM tblClient WHERE sMailAddr2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sMailAddr2

fields.label: City
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sMailCity FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1

fields.label: State
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sMailState FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1

fields.label: Zip
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sMailZip FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1

fields.label: Phone
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sPhoneVoice FROM tblClient WHERE sPhoneVoice IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sPhoneVoice

fields.label: Fax
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sPhoneFAX FROM tblClient WHERE sPhoneFAX IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sPhoneFAX

fields.label: Bill To
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(sBillTo,'') FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sBillTo — dropdown, values: 'Customer', 'Distributor', or blank. NOT an email field — controller aliases sBillTo AS sBillingEmail and maps to BillingEmail record property (misleading name in code). Billing email is at department level (tblDepartment.sBillEmail).

fields.label: Contract Number / Reference
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sReferenceNum FROM tblClient WHERE sReferenceNum IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sReferenceNum

fields.label: Customer Since
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 CONVERT(VARCHAR, dtClientSince, 101) FROM tblClient WHERE dtClientSince IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: dtClientSince

fields.label: Sales Rep
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(sr.sRepFirst + ' ' + sr.sRepLast, '') FROM tblClient c LEFT JOIN tblSalesRep sr ON sr.lSalesRepKey = c.lSalesRepKey ORDER BY c.sClientName1
fields.notes: FK: lSalesRepKey -> tblSalesRep; display = sRepFirst + sRepLast

fields.label: Pricing Category
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 pc.sPricingDescription FROM tblClient c LEFT JOIN tblPricingCategory pc ON pc.lPricingCategoryKey = c.lPricingCategoryKey ORDER BY c.sClientName1
fields.notes: FK: lPricingCategoryKey -> tblPricingCategory.sPricingDescription

fields.label: Payment Terms
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 pt.sTermsDesc FROM tblClient c LEFT JOIN tblPaymentTerms pt ON pt.lPaymentTermsKey = c.lPaymentTermsKey ORDER BY c.sClientName1

fields.label: Distributor
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 d.sDistName1 FROM tblClient c LEFT JOIN tblDistributor d ON d.lDistributorKey = c.lDistributorKey WHERE c.lDistributorKey IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.sClientName1
fields.notes: FK: lDistributorKey -> tblDistributor.sDistName1

fields.label: Active
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 CAST(ISNULL(bActive, 0) AS INT) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1

fields.label: Credit Limit
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 cl.sItemText AS CreditLimit FROM tblClient c LEFT JOIN vwSysCodesCreditLimit cl ON cl.lSystemCodesKey = c.lCreditLimitKey ORDER BY c.sClientName1
fields.notes: Dropdown: lCreditLimitKey -> vwSysCodesCreditLimit.lSystemCodesKey; display = sItemText. Options: 5,000 / 15,000 / 25,000 / 50,000 / 75,000 / 100,000

fields.label: Discount %
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 dblDiscountPct FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1

fields.label: Markup %
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 dblMarkupPct FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: VERIFY: dblMarkupPct column name not confirmed in controller. Also not currently in /full SQL query.

fields.label: Portal Months
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 nPortalMonths FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: nPortalMonths (int) — confirmed from legacy screen showing value 24. DB column confirmed; NOT currently in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: Open Repairs (count)
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblRepair r JOIN tblDepartment d ON d.lDepartmentKey = r.lDepartmentKey WHERE d.lClientKey = c.lClientKey AND ISNULL(r.sRepairClosed,'N') != 'Y') FROM tblClient c ORDER BY c.sClientName1
fields.notes: Subquery count of open repairs across all client departments

fields.label: Revenue
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 1 SUM(ISNULL(i.dblTranAmount,0)) FROM tblInvoice i JOIN tblRepair r ON r.lRepairKey = i.lRepairKey JOIN tblDepartment d ON d.lDepartmentKey = r.lDepartmentKey WHERE d.lClientKey = (SELECT TOP 1 lClientKey FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1)
fields.notes: VERIFY: join path and time window (YTD vs lifetime). Shown in header bar as dollar amount.

fields.label: Blind PS3
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bBlindPS3, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Hides PS3 pricing from customer-facing documents

fields.label: Req. Totals Only
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bRequisitionTotalsOnly, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bRequisitionTotalsOnly

fields.label: Blind Totals On Final
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bBlindTotalsOnFinal, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bBlindTotalsOnFinal

fields.label: Skip Metrics
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bSkipTracking, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bSkipTracking — confirmed no separate bSkipMetrics column exists. Legacy label is 'Skip Metrics'; new portal mislabels a second copy as 'Skip Tracking' — same column.

fields.label: Skip GPO Check
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bSkipGPOCheck, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bSkipGPOCheck — visible on legacy Main tab. DB column confirmed; NOT currently in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: Email New Repairs
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bEmailNewRepairs, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bEmailNewRepairs

fields.label: National Account
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bNationalAccount, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Note: bIsGPO in controller also reads from bNationalAccount

fields.label: PO Required
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(sPORequired, '') FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sPORequired; 'Y' = required

fields.label: Never Hold
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bNeverHold, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bNeverHold

fields.label: Comments
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 LEFT(mComments, 100) FROM tblClient WHERE mComments IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: mComments (memo/text field)

fields.label: Bad Debt Risk
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sBadDebtRisk FROM tblClient WHERE sBadDebtRisk IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sBadDebtRisk (nvarchar). Related: sBadDebtComment for notes. Checkbox on legacy Main tab. DB column confirmed; NOT currently in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: Open Credit Memo
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sOpenCreditMemo FROM tblClient WHERE sOpenCreditMemo IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sOpenCreditMemo (nvarchar). Checkbox on legacy Main tab. DB column confirmed; NOT currently in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: Member Board of Advisors
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sBoardOfAdvisors FROM tblClient WHERE sBoardOfAdvisors IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: sBoardOfAdvisors (nvarchar). Checkbox on legacy Main tab. DB column confirmed; NOT currently in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: Use Adjustment %
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bUseAdjustmentPct, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bUseAdjustmentPct (bit). Paired with dblAdjustmentPct for the actual % value. DB column confirmed; NOT currently in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: Adjustment % Value
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 dblAdjustmentPct FROM tblClient WHERE dblAdjustmentPct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: dblAdjustmentPct (float). Only applies when bUseAdjustmentPct = 1. DB column confirmed; NOT currently in /full SQL query — needs to be added.

fields.label: VA OB10
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bCustomerVAOB10, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bCustomerVAOB10 (bit). Controller maps this to IsNewCustomer record property (misleading name) → JSON: isNewCustomer. Related: bCustomerMemHermOB10 for Mem/Herm OB10 variant (not in API response).

fields.label: National Account / Is GPO
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bNationalAccount, 0) FROM tblClient ORDER BY sClientName1
fields.notes: Column: bNationalAccount (bit). Mapped as IsGPO record property → JSON: isGPO (acronym preserved). Enables GPO membership tab. Also returned as nationalAccount from a second SELECT of the same column.

fields.label: GPO Name
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 g.sGPOName FROM tblClientGPO cg JOIN tblGPO g ON g.lGPOKey = cg.lGPOKey WHERE cg.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: GPOs tab grid col 1. Child table — tblClientGPO links clients to GPO records. Table/column names unverified. Legacy: right-click grid to add.

fields.label: GPO Effective Date
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 dtEffectiveDate FROM tblClientGPO WHERE lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: GPOs tab grid col 2. Column name unverified — likely dtEffectiveDate.

fields.label: GPO End Date
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 dtEndDate FROM tblClientGPO WHERE lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: GPOs tab grid col 3. Column name unverified — likely dtEndDate.

fields.label: GPO ID
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 g.lGPOKey FROM tblClientGPO cg JOIN tblGPO g ON g.lGPOKey = cg.lGPOKey WHERE cg.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: GPOs tab grid col 4. Numeric GPO identifier (e.g. 3039005) — likely lGPOKey or a separate sGPOID string column.

fields.label: GPO GLN
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 g.sGLN FROM tblGPO g JOIN tblClientGPO cg ON cg.lGPOKey = g.lGPOKey WHERE cg.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: GPOs tab grid col 5. Global Location Number (e.g. 1100007320930). Column name unverified — likely sGLN.

fields.label: GPO Company
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 g.sCompany FROM tblGPO g JOIN tblClientGPO cg ON cg.lGPOKey = g.lGPOKey WHERE cg.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: GPOs tab grid col 6. Company name associated with the GPO. Column name unverified.

fields.label: GPO Default
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bDefault, 0) FROM tblClientGPO WHERE lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: GPOs tab grid col 7. Boolean — marks which GPO assignment is the default for this client. Column name unverified.

fields.label: Flag Text
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 sFlag FROM tblFlags WHERE lOwnerKey = <ClientKey> ORDER BY sFlag
fields.notes: Column: sFlag. Flags tab grid col 3. Free-text alert message shown on DI or blank. Legacy: right-click grid to add.

fields.label: Flag Scope Type
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ft.sFlagType FROM tblFlags f JOIN tblFlagTypes ft ON ft.lFlagTypeKey = f.lFlagTypeKey WHERE f.lOwnerKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: tblFlagTypes.sFlagType. Flags tab grid col 1 ('Scope Types'). Categorizes which instrument/scope type the flag applies to.

fields.label: Flag Visible on DI
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bVisibleOnDI, 0) FROM tblFlags WHERE lOwnerKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: bVisibleOnDI (bit). Part of 'Locations' col in legacy Flags tab — controls whether flag appears on delivery inspection.

fields.label: Flag Visible on Blank
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(bVisibleOnBlank, 0) FROM tblFlags WHERE lOwnerKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: bVisibleOnBlank (bit). Part of 'Locations' col in legacy Flags tab — controls whether flag appears on blank/work-order form. Legacy: right-click grid to add.

fields.label: Contact First Name
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 con.sContactFirst FROM tblContacts con JOIN tblContactTran ct ON ct.lContactKey = con.lContactKey WHERE ct.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: sContactFirst. Contacts tab — linked via tblContactTran junction table.

fields.label: Contact Last Name
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 con.sContactLast FROM tblContacts con JOIN tblContactTran ct ON ct.lContactKey = con.lContactKey WHERE ct.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: sContactLast. 'Name' col in legacy grid = Last + First.

fields.label: Contact Phone
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 con.sContactPhoneVoice FROM tblContacts con JOIN tblContactTran ct ON ct.lContactKey = con.lContactKey WHERE ct.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: sContactPhoneVoice.

fields.label: Contact Fax
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 con.sContactPhoneFAX FROM tblContacts con JOIN tblContactTran ct ON ct.lContactKey = con.lContactKey WHERE ct.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: sContactPhoneFAX.

fields.label: Contact Email
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 con.sContactEMail FROM tblContacts con JOIN tblContactTran ct ON ct.lContactKey = con.lContactKey WHERE ct.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: sContactEMail.

fields.label: Contact Active
fields.sqlQuery: SELECT TOP 5 ISNULL(con.bActive, 1) FROM tblContacts con JOIN tblContactTran ct ON ct.lContactKey = con.lContactKey WHERE ct.lClientKey = <ClientKey>
fields.notes: Column: bActive (bit, default 1). Legacy Contacts tab has 'Show Inactive' button. Also: bBillingContact marks primary/billing contact (set via PUT /contacts/{id}/primary).
